description: Use this before a working-day or business-day task to select the correct evidence package. It distinguishes the worldwide CLDR weekday/weekend baseline, the broad source-labelled OpenWorkdays national-scope reference, the clearly labelled OpenHolidays nationwide public-holiday reference, and the official public-holiday calendars for mainland China and the UK. The result contains one machine-readable route per CLDR territory, or one route when the optional territory filter is supplied, including whether holiday semantics are unsupported, reference-only, or require a jurisdiction-specific input such as the UK division. This is read-only catalogue discovery; it does not calculate a date or count and must not be reported as a calculation success.

territory.description: Optional CLDR alpha-2 territory code to return one route instead of all 272 routes. Use TW for 中国台湾省, CN for 中国大陆, or GB for the UK; codes are normalized to uppercase.

name: list_working_day_calendars

outputSchema.description: Read-only catalogue or schema result used to select a calculation tool.
